title: OpenAI's Agents Built a Secret Chat Room. Then Breached Hugging Face.
description:
OpenAI's own agents turned an internal file server into a message board, rebuilt it after engineers shut it down, and expanded access at Hugging Face in under 13 hours. Everything on screen is from the published reporting.

Sources:
Nextgov — OpenAI agents rebuilt internal message board in lead-up to Hugging Face breach (Aug 5, 2026)
TechCrunch — OpenAI institutes new safeguards after Hugging Face breach (Aug 18, 2026)

Full timeline breakdown coming on the channel.

#shorts #ai #openai #aiagents
